basis: S12a (2026-10-26.3 after review R1-R4 and their remainders on PR #361): user rulings 2026-10-26 after the S12 error analysis found about 28% of segment errors were Golden or scoring artifacts. (1) Near-identical passages across documents credit each other once 本合同/本条款/本附加合同 are folded, still by exact containment of at least copy_min_chars. Numbers never fold: a footnote mark cannot be told from a real number by text (a unit blacklist missed 小时; a connective whitelist folded 10或20年), so the footnote half of ruling 1 is not applied. (2) Headings and reader-guide lines of terms and brochures are neutral; rate-table cells are not headings. (3) Brochure restatements are neutral for a field whose Golden cites the terms; footnote blocks and the definitions section (opened by a heading or a chapter heading of any length naming 释义) are neutral unless the field's card asks for definitions or footnotes.
clause_number_pattern: ^\s*(?:第[一二三四五六七八九十百零\d]+[条章节]|\d+(?:\.\d+)+|\d+[、.．]|[（(][一二三四五六七八九十\d]+[）)])
chapter_heading_pattern: ^(?:第[一二三四五六七八九十百零\d]+章|\d+[.．、](?!\d))
